name: mcp-flightcheck
description: Tries to break your MCP server before your users do. Runtime checks with spec citations, made for CI.
author: Ofir Pardo

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "dist-test/test/*.test.js"
scripts.demo: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node dist-test/examples/demo.js
